This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **22** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

- `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`  _(via crm_lead (literal, a string literal in fixture))_
- `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`  _(via crm_lead (literal, a string literal in fixture))_

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via retiredAfter (symbol, a field of const object translationLocaleTagCaseFolded), retiredFromLoadPath (symbol, a field of const object translationLocaleTagCaseFolded), crm_lead (literal, a string literal in fixture))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `730db33ae6afd62ddb4ebfb250310f9d4b983f13` — the merge of head `62f265f03245d8118b52b7dfdb461208ea52dc06` into base `a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 730db33ae6afd62ddb4ebfb250310f9d4b983f13 && git checkout 730db33ae6afd62ddb4ebfb250310f9d4b983f13
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f 62f265f03245d8118b52b7dfdb461208ea52dc06 && git checkout -B drift-repro a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f && git merge --no-ff 62f265f03245d8118b52b7dfdb461208ea52dc06

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a7e6e07ff9bb777b688c0424da1cdd9790e11f5f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.translation-locale-case-canonicalized.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.translation-locale-non-tag-refused.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts, packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json + packages/spec/scripts/lib/dropped-refinements.ts, packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts, packages/spec/scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/apply.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/retired-after.census.test.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/conversions.test.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-renderer.ts, packages/spec/package.json

Delta review over the two at-tier PASS records on PR #29190 at `263f6c891eac65f49418adc1f13aa7004bf6b9be`: 6577781599 (domain:spec#1) and 6577787009 (triage#1). PR #29833 supersedes the closed draft #29190 (closed 2026-11-03T06:43:39Z, unmerged, head `263f6c89`). Every judgment of those two records not restated below stands and is adopted for `62f265f0`. Inputs: `git diff origin/main...62f265f0` against `git diff 6b3ba82c 263f6c89` file by file; the merge commit's two parents; `git merge-tree --write-tree b3d14150 263f6c89`; every comment on #28993 through 6597236864 and the ruling 6595806433 (letter A); the PR body of #29833; the check-runs on `62f265f0`, polled until none was pending. Nothing was built, run or checked out; the template was printed with `record-recognisers.mjs --template`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The head is #29190's five commits plus one merge, and nothing else** — RIGHT. `62f265f0` has parents `263f6c89` (#29190's head) and `b3d14150` (main at merge time; `origin/main` is now one commit further, `a7e6e07f`, which touches none of the nine files). The five non-merge commits `5397e120`, `102f342e`, `3b3284c9`, `713814b9`, `263f6c89` have stable patch-ids identical to #29190's five. `git merge-tree --write-tree b3d14150 263f6c89` conflicts in exactly one path, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, and the head's tree differs from the merge-tree result in that one file only: `registry.ts` and the pin test auto-merged, and the head carries the auto-merge result byte for byte.
2. **The net diff is the same change the earlier records judged, file by file** — RIGHT. Nine files on both sides, same list. Six files (`.changeset/28993-locale-case-canonicalized.md`, `i18n-standard.mdx`, both semantic entries, `translation.test.ts`, `translation.zod.ts`) have byte-identical hunks, because main did not move their base. `registry.ts` (191 changed lines) and `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (33 changed lines) have identical added and removed lines; only hunk headers and one context line move (main added +321/−13 to the registry and +13/−1 to the pin test under them). No hunk differs in content. The one file whose hunks differ is the ledger, judged in ①3.
3. **The ledger resolution** — RIGHT, recounted against the tree. The gate (`scripts/lib/dropped-refinements.ts#checkDroppedRefinements`, called by `build-schemas.ts`) compares each entry's `sites` as a set plus its length against the build's census; order inside a list is not judged; `scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts` pins `measured.publishedSchemasWithDroppedRefinements` to the number of entries and `measured.droppedRefinementSites` to the sum of `sites.length`. Parsed both files: main has 250 entries / 1012 sites, the head 250 / 1018, header fields equal to the body on both; the entry key order is identical to main's; `description`, `zod`, `refinementSitesThatDidProject` (369) and `refinementSitesWithNoJsonFormToCompare` (0) unchanged. Entry-by-entry set difference main → head: `api/AssembledInstalledPackage` +`manifest.translations.element` (78 → 79), `api/GetInstalledPackageResponse` +`data.options[1].manifest.translations.element` (74 → 75), `api/InstalledPackageAtEitherStage` +`options[1].manifest.translations.element` (78 → 79), `api/ListInstalledPackagesResponse` +`data.packages.element.options[1].manifest.translations.element` (72 → 73), `system/PlatformTranslationBundle` and `system/TranslationBundle` +`""` (6 → 7 each); no removal in any entry, no entry lost, no duplicate path introduced, no other entry touched. Those are exactly the six sites #29190 added over `6b3ba82c` (same six entries, same six paths, 983 → 989 there). The four `api/*` lists grew by four each on main between the two bases (#29162 and later), which is the whole of the conflict; main's re-sort of `notices.valueType.message` is kept as main has it. The ledger is hand-edited by design (no generator; `build-schemas.ts` says so), so a hand resolution is the prescribed shape, and the dev's `check:generated --fix` touching nothing is consistent with that.
4. **Nothing main brought in since `263f6c89` contradicts the earlier judgments** — RIGHT. `translation.zod.ts`, `translation.test.ts`, both semantic entries, `conversions/types.ts`, `conversions.test.ts`, `retired-after.census.test.ts`, `walk.ts`, `artifact-forward-conversion.ts`, `authored-translation-sync.ts` and `memory-i18n.ts` are untouched on main since `6b3ba82c`. The registry on main gained two D2 entries at `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'` (`form-view-drawer-keys-removed`, order 81; `view-personal-declarations-removed`, order 82) and nothing near 76 / 76.5; the head's `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` holds `translationLocaleTagCanonicalized` at 76 and `translationLocaleTagCaseFolded` at 76.5 with no duplicate order, `inApplicationOrder` unchanged, `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[18]` built from it. `@objectstack/spec` is still `18.2.0` on main and on the head, so the new entry's stamp is still at the newest published stable and the pin test's first guard still demands its JOIN row. The merged pin test holds main's two new rows (`form-view-drawer-keys-removed`, `view-personal-declarations-removed`, with the `ViewScopeSchema` / `ViewSharingSchema` import main added) beside this PR's `translation-locale-tag-case-folded` row and its `todo` renderer; the `names no release` guard is present once. `apply.ts` and `stored.ts` changed only docblocks (a retirement kit ages out one major after it retires, ruling 6434038284) and `stored.ts` added `object_extension` to `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`; neither moves a toMajor-18 entry replayed on an 18 runtime, and `translations` stays in that map. `refused-shapes.ts` gained nothing naming a translation or locale. `migrations/registry.ts.template` gained two text entries (orders 116, 117) for main's retirements; this PR adds no template entry, exactly as #29190 did not. `stack.zod.ts#warnEmailTemplateLocaleFloor` and `template-renderer.ts#localeCandidates`, the two exact matchers the D3 entry names, are still there under the names the entry gives.
5. **The ruling is what the head carries** — RIGHT. 6595806433 (letter A, maintainer 同意 2026-11-03T04:55Z) binds: a `TranslationBundle` / `PlatformTranslationBundle` holding two keys that fold to one tag is refused at the parse naming both keys and the tag; declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`; B not taken. At the head, both bundle schemas are `z.record(LocaleTagKeySchema, …).superRefine(refuseLocaleKeysFoldingTogether).overwrite(foldLocaleKeys)`, and the refinement adds a `custom` issue at the second key whose message names `first`, `key` and `tag` and the release (`Refused since @objectstack/spec 18`); the prepared merge swap is absent from the diff. The card body carries `Ruled: 6595806433 · letter A` and `Ruling-ref: 6595806433`; the PR body carries `Ruling-ref: 6595806433` and `Supersedes #29190`.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged by the merge and CORRECT. The changeset at the head: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, title `feat(spec)!:`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, one **BREAKING** banner with its FROM → TO migration (a bundle holding both spellings → one canonical key, merged by hand), exactly one ADR-0087 marker `registered translation-locale-case-canonicalized`. The PR body carries the same two declaration lines and the same title. The diff adds no authorable key, removes none, moves no published JSON Schema (the ledger's +6 sites are the `superRefine` with no JSON form, at the bundle roots and the four `api/*InstalledPackage*` embeddings); the one refused input is the colliding pair, so `narrowed` over `semantic` and `(narrowing)` ⇒ BREAKING at `minor`. `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Gate verdicts on `62f265f0`:** 69 check-runs, all completed at 07:03Z (polled from 06:48Z, 16 polls): 58 `success`, 10 `skipped` (Lint UI, Auto Label, Check PR Size, Dogfood Verify CLI, the Dogfood Regression Gate shard matrix, Temporal Conformance, UI Published Artifacts, the schedule gate, the two opt-in harnesses — the same skip set as on `263f6c89`), 1 `failure`, 0 pending. `Check Changeset`, `Build Core`, every `Test Core` shard, every Type Check and Lint job are `success`.
- **The PR-body guards failure at 06:41:09Z–06:41:39Z** is the duplicate `Fixes #28993` while #29190 was still open (#29190 closed 06:43:39Z); a second `PR-body guards` run started 06:44:19Z is `success`. Read as superseded, as the dispatch said to expect.
- **PR state:** draft, `mergeable: null` / `mergeable_state: unknown` at read time (GitHub had not yet computed it against `a7e6e07f`); `git merge-tree` of the head onto `origin/main` is outside this record's scope, but `a7e6e07f` touches none of the nine files, so no new conflict follows from it.
- **Ledger counts in the PR body** (1012 → 1018 on `b3d14150`; 983 → 989 on `6b3ba82c`) match the recount in ①3.
- **Dogfood battery on the resumed head** (dev report 6597236864): command-exit 0, 404 files passed, 3 skipped, no failure; the `package-first-authoring` boot timeout noted on `263f6c89` did not recur. A dev-reported local run, not a gate verdict; noted, nothing to escalate.
- **Carried from 6577781599 / 6577787009 unchanged:** the save door stores the authored body (domain:server sibling card); `memory-i18n.ts#resolveLocale` untouched; nothing under `packages/metadata-protocol` touched; the generated `registry.ts` not hand-edited beyond the entries the records judged; the mdx a bounded in-place fix outside the claim surface; the ninth file (the pin test) forced by the census guard. The open question those records left to the maintainer is now ruled (①5), so it is closed, not carried.
- **Seat identity:** the earlier records' `Implemented-by` named `claude/project-thread-ih2cyh`; the resumed branch is `claude/project-thread-bo9b0g`, holding the same five commits (patch-id identical) plus the merge. This record names the branch that produced the reviewed head.

### ④ Design judgment

On a merge-only delta the design judgments of 6577781599 (④, every `hits` file) and 6577787009 (④) are adopted whole; nothing in the merge moves the fold, the key twin, the refusal, the D2 entry, its order, its stamp, the D3 entry or the pin row, and ①4 reads the main-side changes that could have moved their premises and finds none did. Re-read on this head and holding: `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` still sorts by numeric `order` with ties by id, so 76 then 76.5 still gives `zh_cn` → `zh-cn` → `zh-CN`; the census pin still derives the release from `retiredAfter` at the newest published stable (`18.2.0` on both sides), so the `todo` row is still demanded and still satisfied by a message naming `@objectstack/spec 18`; the three entries stamped `18.2.0` on the merged head each carry a JOIN row.

**`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`** (the one hand-resolved file) — judged against the gate that reads it (`checkDroppedRefinements`, set-and-length per entry; the ledger test's header-equals-body pin). HOLDS: ①3 is the full recount. No finding.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
